chars.name: Consort Knife
chars.cue: ×5 · CR 4 · Unbowed killer in musician's livery. One mark each.

items: **Two Kissed Stilettos.**
**Against its mark:** one defense roll a round, d20 + the champion's Def vs **DC 18**. A fail moves them one step right.
**Against a PC:** two defense rolls vs **DC 18**. **13** each on a fail (6 piercing + 7 poison).
**A PC dropped to 0** is Kissed: auto-fails a death save each turn, and takes 7 poison a turn after waking until cured.
**Marked.** Ignores PCs unless they grapple it, block its path, or stand over its fallen mark.
**Strikes last** each round, initiative 1.
**Uncanny Dodge.** Halves one hit a round.
**Cunning Action.** Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
**Step Tablet (2/day, bonus).** Teleports 30 ft. Needs a free hand.
**Swallowed (crowd 5).** Its next strike: defense roll at disadvantage.
**Grapple:** Athletics or Acrobatics **DC 16**. A grappled Knife can't snap a tablet. Triggers marksman Overwatch.
**Snatch the tablet (action):** Sleight of Hand **DC 16**. Belaskro's whip can try from 10 ft.
**Shoulder to shoulder:** attacks against it have advantage while its mark is on their feet.
Snaps its **Passage Tablet** (dimension door to a fixed exit) when its mark dies, at **26 HP**, or at the **end of round 5**.
Can't leave while grappled, restrained, or once the tablet is taken.
**Intimidation DC 16, with disadvantage.** It knows its mark, the signal and its exit point. Nothing more.
Unbowed fist tattoo inside the forearm.
Tablet iron band, **Investigation DC 14:** a rune shop's batch stamp.
Str +0 · Dex +4 · Con +2 · Int +1 · Wis +1 · Cha +1
**Saves:** Dex +6, Int +3
**Skills:** Acrobatics +6, Sleight of Hand +6, Stealth +8, Performance +3
Passive Perception 11

chars.name: Consort Marksman
chars.cue: ×2 · CR 2 · At the loggia rail above the dais.

items: **Two light crossbow bolts** at the most exposed PC. Initiative 10.
Two defense rolls vs **DC 17**. **6** each on a fail.
Each hit: **DC 12 Con** save or poisoned until the end of their next turn. Fail again while poisoned: unconscious until the end of their next turn, or until damaged or shaken awake.
**In the crowd:** +2 to the defense roll (half cover).
**Reaction:** one bolt at anyone who grapples a Knife, stands over a Knife's fallen mark, or climbs toward the loggia.
**Exposed** means any of those, on the grand stair, flying, or outside the crowd.
**Wall of Silk (crowd 4):** no shots this round.
The loggia is an upper hallway above and behind the dais, open to the courtyard.
**At the rail:** half cover against attacks from the floor (treat as AC 16).
**Up:** a small stair at each end, or climb with Athletics **DC 13**.
Snaps its **Passage Tablet** at **16 HP** or at the **end of round 6**.
Can't leave while grappled, restrained, or once the tablet is taken.
Unbowed fist tattoo, same as the Knives.
Str +0 · Dex +3 · Con +1 · Int +0 · Wis +2 · Cha +0
**Skills:** Perception +4, Stealth +5
Passive Perception 14 · Speed 30

chars.name: The Hand
chars.cue: CR 6 · The professional. Upstairs, at Cassian's wards. No tattoo.

items: **Six wards** ring Cassian's bed. It breaks **one at the end of every round**. The last goes at the end of round 6.
While any ward stands it cannot come within 10 ft of the bed or target Cassian.
**A PC enters the room:** it stops breaking wards and fights them. The clock stops.
**Shore up a ward (action):** Arcana **DC 14**, or **DC 10** with a blank rune tablet. Max 6.
**Two Kissed Blades.** Two defense rolls vs **DC 19**. **14** each on a fail (7 piercing + 7 poison).
**A PC dropped to 0** is Kissed, as with the Knives.
**Cassian fights beside the PC:** PC attacks against the Hand have advantage, and the Hand takes **14 fire** a round. No roll.
**Uncanny Dodge.** Halves one hit a round.
**Cunning Action.** Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.
**Step Tablet (2/day, bonus).** Teleports 30 ft.
**Resists poison.** Climb 20.
Snaps its **Passage Tablet** at **45 HP**, or once Cassian is dead.
If nobody comes: Cassian is Kissed at the end of round 6 and dead at the end of round 7.
Str +2 · Dex +4 · Con +2 · Int +2 · Wis +2 · Cha +0
**Saves:** Dex +7, Int +5, Wis +5
**Skills:** Acrobatics +7, Athletics +5, Perception +5, Stealth +10
Passive Perception 15

chars.name: Éclair
chars.cue: House Puss · catfolk duellist · the only champion with a blade.

items: **Track:** Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead.
**Riposte:** every successful defense, her Knife takes **9**.
No Shield spell. Her player rolls d20 + 5 vs DC 18.
**Natural 20:** she counters and the Knife is prone.
HP 90 · Speed 40, climb 20 · difficult terrain costs her nothing.
**Dress rapier ×3:** +8, 9 piercing each.
**Exhibition Flourish (recharge 5–6):** one rapier attack with advantage, +14 damage, DC 16 Con or stunned.
Saves: Dex +8, Cha +6. Acrobatics +11.

chars.name: Garrick
chars.cue: House Moravel · two winters on the northern wall.

items: **Track:** Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead.
**Garrison Volley (recharge 5–6):** his player rolls a d6 at the top of the round. On 5–6 one Knife takes **15**.
**Shield (2):** +5 after a failed defense roll.
Gala dress: unarmed, AC already reduced by 2.
HP 78 · Speed 30.
**Rune Bolt ×2:** +6, range 120 ft, 12 force each.
Saves: Con +5, Cha +6. Arcana +5.

chars.name: Noémie
chars.cue: House Vayne · Oss'kai lineage light, passed off as sorcery.

items: **Track:** Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead.
**Cleansing Flare (recharge 5–6):** her player rolls a d6 at the top of the round. On 5–6, 20-ft radius: every champion in it is cured and wakes (Steady), and each Knife in it takes **18 radiant**.
The whole court sees green-gold light. Don't explain it.
**Shield (2):** +5 after a failed defense roll.
HP 78 · Speed 30.
**Rune Bolt ×2:** +6, range 120 ft, 12 force each.
Saves: Con +5, Cha +6. Arcana +5.
**Track:** Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead.
**Mirror Mantle:** ignore his first failed defense.
**Shield (2):** +5 after a failed defense roll.
Gala dress: unarmed, AC already reduced by 2.
HP 78 · Speed 30.
**Rune Bolt ×2:** +6, range 120 ft, 12 force each.
Saves: Con +5, Cha +6. Arcana +5.

chars.name: Rowan
chars.cue: House Halvenne · Lady Odile's brother. Seated nearest the party.

items: **Track:** Steady → Bleeding → Kissed (3 pips) → Dead.
**Riposte:** once a PC hands him a blade, every successful defense deals his Knife **9**.
**Shield (2):** +5 after a failed defense roll.
Gala dress: unarmed, AC already reduced by 2.
HP 78 · Speed 30.
**Rune Bolt ×2:** +6, range 120 ft, 12 force each.
**Duelling Blade** (if armed): +5, 7 piercing.
Saves: Con +5, Cha +6.

chars.name: Cassian
chars.cue: Injured, in bed, behind six wards. No audience, so no Crowd Favourite.

items: Safe while any ward stands.
**Last ward gone (end of round 6):** Kissed. **End of round 7:** dead unless a PC is in the room.
Cures and waking work on him as on the champions.
PC attacks against the Hand have **advantage**.
He deals the Hand **14 fire** each round. No roll.
**Is That All You've Got (reaction):** reduces one hit on him by 5.

chars.name: Wrent
chars.cue: Marshal Lieutenant in dress uniform. Gus's player rolls for him.

items: Hit in the opening volley: **starts Bleeding**.
**Top of round 1:** dives over a Kissed champion, two crowd boxes from Gus.
The Knife must go through him: d20 + 4 vs **DC 18**. He uses the champion track.
Gus can wake him and stand over him. **Only Gabriele or Timbit can cure him.**
**If he dies:** hand Shane the Annex C handout.

chars.name: Marshals
chars.cue: Constable-Adepts. Push in past the crowd in round 6.

items: Those inside the hall were dropped by the marksmen before initiative.
**Round 6:** reinforcements reach the floor through the garden doors.
By then the Knives are gone. They secure the room and call for healers.

chars.name: Corvane
chars.cue: Trapped in the dome with the Queen until round 10.

items: The shield-rune dome holds him for **10 rounds**. Nothing passes in or out.
**Round 10:** the dome falls and he runs for the stairs.
**Insight DC 14 on the Queen beside him:** shaken for real; she looks to the stairs first.
**Nothing Left to Lose:** while Cassian is in danger and in sight, advantage on attacks and resistance to all damage.
**Crested Warhammer ×3:** +8, 13 bludgeoning, DC 16 Str or pushed 5 ft.
**A Word to the Wise (recharge 5–6):** DC 15 Wis or frightened for 1 minute.
Cannot be surprised. Saves: Str +8, Con +8, Wis +6.
AC 18 assumes his half plate and shield. Your call what he wears at his own gala.
Cure Wounds (wakes, does not cure).
**Three blank rune tablets:** shore up a ward at DC 10.
**Whip:** snatch a Knife's tablet from 10 ft, Sleight of Hand +4 vs DC 16.
Arcana +0 · Medicine +2 · Athletics +3 · Acrobatics +4
**Cures:** Lesser Restoration, Protection from Poison.
**Wakes:** Healing Word (60 ft), Cure Wounds, a healing potion.
**Preserve Life:** wakes every Kissed champion within 30 ft.
Arcana +7 · Medicine +3
Cure Wounds (wakes, does not cure).
**Steel defender** can stand over a champion as Protect.
**Thieves' tools** for Cassian's door, DC 15.
Arcana +5 for the wards · Medicine +1
**Cures:** Lesser Restoration (bonus action), Protection from Poison.
**Wakes:** Healing Word, Cure Wounds.
**Spare the Dying:** holds the count for a round.
Needs a 17 to avoid a Knife. Arcana +5 · Medicine +1
